edu.btc.whatIsIt: Bitcoin is a digital asset designed to operate without a central bank. People often explore it as a globally transferable store of value.
edu.btc.howItWorks: Bitcoin runs on a public blockchain. Transactions are verified by a distributed network rather than a single company.
edu.btc.whyPeopleUseIt: People explore Bitcoin for digital ownership, global accessibility, and a long track record as a crypto market reference asset.
edu.btc.beginnerNotes: Prices can move quickly. Start by understanding what the asset is, how quotes work, and what risks exist before making any decision.
edu.btc.riskNotes: High price volatility can occur. Values can rise or fall sharply over short periods.
edu.btc.plainLanguageSummary: Bitcoin is a digital asset designed to operate without a central bank. Its price can move significantly, so understand the asset before investing.
edu.btc.characteristics.3: Often treated as a market benchmark in crypto
edu.eth.whatIsIt: Ether (ETH) is the native asset of the Ethereum network, a blockchain used for applications and digital tokens.
edu.eth.howItWorks: Ethereum supports smart contracts. ETH is used to pay for network activity and participate in the ecosystem.
edu.eth.whyPeopleUseIt: People explore ETH because many applications, tokens, and on-chain services are built on Ethereum.
edu.eth.beginnerNotes: Network fees and application complexity can be confusing at first. Focus on understanding the asset and the venue before acting.
edu.eth.riskNotes: High price volatility can occur. Application and network conditions can also change over time.
edu.eth.plainLanguageSummary: ETH is the native asset of Ethereum. It supports a large ecosystem of applications, and its price can move significantly.
edu.sol.whatIsIt: SOL is the native asset of the Solana blockchain, used for network fees and activity in that ecosystem.
edu.sol.howItWorks: Solana is designed for fast, low-cost transactions. SOL is used to pay for activity on the network.
edu.sol.whyPeopleUseIt: People explore SOL for speed, lower typical fees, and access to applications built on Solana.
edu.sol.beginnerNotes: Newer networks can feel busy and unfamiliar. Learn how quotes and venues work before making decisions.
edu.sol.riskNotes: High price volatility can occur. Network outages or congestion have happened in the past on some blockchain networks.
edu.sol.plainLanguageSummary: SOL is the native asset of Solana. People explore it for fast network activity, and its price can move significantly.
edu.sol.whyExplore.2: Often discussed for lower typical fees
edu.sol.characteristics.2: Commonly traded as an on-chain ecosystem asset
edu.usdc.whatIsIt: USDC is a digital dollar-style stablecoin designed to track the value of the U.S. dollar as closely as possible.
edu.usdc.howItWorks: USDC is issued as a token on supported blockchains and is commonly used as a quote currency in crypto markets.
edu.usdc.whyPeopleUseIt: People explore USDC to hold a dollar-referenced balance digitally and to price trades against other assets.
edu.usdc.beginnerNotes: Stablecoins aim for price stability relative to a fiat currency, but they still involve issuer, custody, and market risks.
edu.usdc.riskNotes: Stablecoins can deviate from their target value in stressed markets. Understand issuer and venue risk before relying on them.
edu.usdc.plainLanguageSummary: USDC is designed to track the U.S. dollar. It is often used as a quote currency when exploring other digital assets.
edu.usdc.whyExplore.0: Designed to track the U.S. dollar
edu.usdc.whyExplore.1: Common quote currency in crypto markets
edu.usdc.whyExplore.2: Useful for comparing other asset prices
edu.usdc.whyExplore.3: Still carries issuer and market risks
edu.usdc.characteristics.1: Often used as a pricing unit (quote asset)
edu.usdc.characteristics.2: Intended for lower day-to-day price swings than many cryptocurrencies
edu.generic.whatIsIt: {{label}} ({{symbol}}) is a digital market asset available through EthMarket discovery.
edu.generic.howItWorks: Market prices and availability come from connected market venues. EthMarket helps you discover, understand, and request live quotes.
edu.generic.whyPeopleUseIt: People explore assets like this to learn how digital markets work before making any decision.
edu.generic.beginnerNotes: Read the available market details, compare with other assets, and request a quote only when you understand what you are looking at.
edu.generic.riskNotes: Digital asset prices can move quickly. Missing information should be treated as unavailable, not as zero risk.
edu.generic.plainLanguageSummary: {{label}} is a digital market asset. Review available market data and educational notes before making any decision.
edu.generic.whyExplore.1: Can be compared with other assets
